correctness.rationale: Piecewise unimodular gap-simplex chambers have Dirichlet(1,...,1) gaps. Their first and second moments give explicit covariance entries, layer-contrast eigenvalues and rank-k block covariance; the matrix determinant lemma proves the formula. Rational checker reconstructs the second moments and determinants independently in 15 examples and checks two strict exact cube comparisons. Stirling and uniform large-layer asymptotics prove the limit and sign.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General order/chain volume results imply chamber weights, not the covariance determinant. The Hanner theorem covers centrally symmetric polytopes only, so cannot dominate this noncentral family.

value.rationale: The isotropic constant is a natural affine invariant of convex bodies. Exact determinant and covariance spectra for an arbitrary layered ordinal-sum family give reproducible nontrivial information beyond known volumes. The asymptotic below-cube law with universal negative logarithmic leading correction, despite the two-singleton-layer example lying above the cube, is a motivated structural transition rather than a routine finite computation.
